title: Higher-order states may be necessary but not sufficient

statements.text: On the joint determination view, inference on higher-order states is necessary for awareness but not sufficient, and first-order states contribute to the content of experience. How much each level contributes is an empirical question.

sources.quote: However, while inference on higher-order states is, on this view, necessary for awareness, it may not be sufficient.
a variant of the “joint determination” view advocated by Lau and Brown
